heroVideo.title: Don’t Walk It Off
heroVideo.caption: 60 sec · captioned
heroVideo.transcript:
You walked away from the crash. Said, “I’m good.” Even called home: “I’m fine. For real.” Next morning? Stiff neck. Tight back. Headaches.

After a crash, symptoms can show up hours, even days later. And Florida PIP generally requires care within fourteen days. So don’t walk it off. Call (844) 84-TREAT.

At Therapy & Injury, your first visit is simple: a conversation about how you got hurt, a chiropractic exam, and a clear plan, in plain language. Bring your photo ID, insurance card, and crash report, if you have one. Chiropractic care, with or without a referral.

Don’t wait out the clock. Get checked. Visit therapyandinjury.com, or call now: (844) 84-TREAT.

services.name: Injury evaluation
services.short: A chiropractic history and exam focused on how you were hurt, how you move, and what you feel.
services.body:
Your first visit starts with a conversation about how the injury happened, where you feel symptoms, and how they affect daily life. A chiropractic physician then performs a hands-on examination, which may include posture, range of motion, orthopedic and neurological screening tests, and palpation.

We explain what we find in plain language. If anything suggests you need a medical evaluation, imaging, or care outside chiropractic scope, we refer you to an independent medical provider.

services.name: Chiropractic adjustments
services.short: Specific spinal and extremity adjustments, explained before they happen and tailored to your comfort.
services.body:
An adjustment is a controlled, specific movement applied to a joint that is not moving well. Your doctor will explain the technique before using it and adapt it to your comfort level, injury, and preferences.

Techniques used: [LIST TECHNIQUES — e.g., diversified, drop-table, instrument-assisted, low-force options].

services.name: Rehabilitation & therapeutic exercise
services.short: Guided movement to rebuild mobility, strength, and stability, plus a simple plan for home.
services.body:
Guided exercises help you move with more confidence as you recover. Programs are chosen for your injury and stage of recovery, and progress gradually.

You will also get a short home program to do between visits. {rehabEquipment}

services.name: Soft-tissue therapy
services.short: Hands-on techniques for muscles and connective tissue that are tight or guarded after injury.
services.body:
Muscles and connective tissue often tighten and guard after an injury. Soft-tissue techniques work directly with those tissues as part of your overall chiropractic care plan.

Techniques used: [LIST TECHNIQUES — e.g., trigger point, instrument-assisted soft-tissue work, stretching].
